improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
improve.coach: 43% overall, 20% in your last five. Better every week.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
improve.coach: Flagged 43% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
improve.coach: Worse lately: 60% versus 36%. We'll work on it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it. 57% of your matches. Signature move.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. 43% of matches. Your calling card.

coach.intro: Let's sit down, tuxedo_slide. 14 matches worth of notes.
